repository_state.notes: Phase 1 Foundation scaffolding implemented under jarvis_core/: config, observability, permissions, plugin loader, storage, core service. 20 automated tests exist and pass (pytest). Not yet CI-wired, not yet security-reviewed as a phase, no first-party plugins ship yet.

implemented_features: Layered config system (defaults -> YAML file -> env overrides), validated via Pydantic (jarvis_core/config)
Structured logging to console + rotating file (jarvis_core/observability)
SQLite storage layer with permission_grants and audit_log tables (jarvis_core/storage)
Capability-based permission system: deny-by-default store, tier classification, require() enforcement gate with audit logging (jarvis_core/permissions)
Plugin manifest schema + directory-based discovery with per-plugin failure isolation (jarvis_core/plugins)
Core HTTP service (FastAPI/Uvicorn, loopback-only) with /health and /status endpoints (jarvis_core/service)
verified_features: Config system: 4 automated tests passing (defaults, file override, env override, path resolution)
Permission system: 8 automated tests passing (deny-by-default, grant/revoke, full-catalog seeding, tier mapping, require() allow/deny paths, audit-log write)
Plugin discovery/registry: 6 automated tests passing (empty dir, missing dir, valid manifest, invalid manifest isolation, no-manifest dir skipped, registry register/get/list)
Core service: 2 automated tests passing (in-process /health and /status), plus one manual real-socket smoke test confirming the service boots, serves real HTTP, and persists a real SQLite file
known_risks: Primary device (HP EliteBook 645 G9) has no dedicated GPU, so the local-tier/cloud-tier split (D-0006) is a hard constraint on later phases, not a preference.
No CI pipeline exists yet -- tests must be run manually (`pytest`) before each commit until CI is wired up.
No formal security review has been performed on this Foundation pass -- required before Phase 1 can be marked complete per roadmap.md's completion bar.
No first-party plugins exist yet, so plugin isolation has only been tested against synthetic fixtures, not a real plugin.
Android integration approach and specific cloud AI provider(s)/cost ceiling remain open, deferred to Phase 7 and Phase 3 respectively -- not blocking for Phase 1.
next_actions: Owner review of this Foundation pass.
Wire up CI to run pytest automatically on push.
Perform and record a security review of the permission/plugin/service layers before declaring Phase 1 complete.
Write phase_completion_records/P001-completion.md only once the full completion bar in roadmap.md is met (a partial pass, however solid, is not 'complete').
Decide what real capability Phase 1 should be exercised against next (e.g. a first trivial plugin, or moving into Phase 3 AI provider wiring).
